payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over rows with state (even_color, odd_color) minimizes changes to achieve alternating two-color rows, ensuring vertical adjacency constraints via O(26^2) transition with prefix/suffix minima.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP table dp[i][c1][c2] to represent minimum changes up to row i with colors c1 and c2 for even and odd columns. Transitions combine initial mismatches with minimal previous row cost under color-difference constraints, typical of dp_2d_state.
